matches.text: try{const response=await base44.functions.invoke('smartsheetSyncAction',{action:'conflict_list',session_token:sessionToken,status,dataset,cursor});const data=response.data;if(!data?.success)throw new Error(data?.error||'Reviews could not be loaded.');setItems(old=>cursor?[...old,...data.page.items]:data.page.items);setPage(data.page);setCount(data.count);}catch(error){setMessage(error?.response?.data?.error||error.message);}finally{setLoading(false);}
